sentences.en: The price of stock declined by half in a month.
sentences.zh: 股票的价格在一个月内下降了一半。

sentences.en: The birthrate will continue to decline for years to come.
sentences.zh: 未来几年出生率将持续下降。

sentences.en: The institution of marriage appears to be on the decline.
sentences.zh: 婚姻制度似乎正在衰落。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：de（向下）+clin（倾斜）+e →向下倾斜→下降，衰退
